description: Praszczur, the ghost of an ancient forefather, a tall old bearded man in a plain white linen shirt with a woven red belt, a translucent pale blue ghostly body, eyes glowing like embers, holding a heavy gnarled wooden staff diagonally across his body in both hands, ready to strike, stern and menacing, standing on both feet, full body, three-quarter view, the ghost alone, no ground, no background, the whole figure and the whole staff inside the picture, with space above the head
